sphereSection.method: 85m diameter/overall height constraints plus actual side/aerial proportions; sphere centre and lower/top cuts chosen to reproduce truncated body with shallow glass roof, not a complete85m ball stacked atop13m annex
sphereSection.uncertainty: centre±5m, lower cut±4m, gold top/skylight base±3m; neutral base not surveyed; OSM max ring108m conflicting and not scaled to force fit

floorBands.method: representative15 sphere-floor bands from engineering scope, terrace/gold-glass alternation observed; label18 press and19 historical whole-building counts not asserted as the same quantity
floorBands.uncertainty: actual current bands/floor datum and terrace depths unknown; recess±.6m, glass ratio reported but actual segment inventory unmeasured

glazedFace.method: theatre-facing glazed wedge visible in official operator view; axis follows source corridor toward theatre, width by approximate frontal proportion
glazedFace.uncertainty: angular width±.12rad, depth±1.5m; precise curved glass mounting/buttress layout pending

podium.method: rounded gold oval wings divided by source front/rear glazed corridors; curved section fitted to actual supplier close view and operator aerial, outer plan follows source ring
podium.uncertainty: section/radius±4m, gap phase±5deg;13m overall annex is reported, individual roof intersections are estimated; source podium tag20 rejected

entryGlazing.method: source front/rear corridor polygons with sloping glazed roof and a shallow steel/glass projecting canopy seen in real entry photograph
entryGlazing.uncertainty: heights±4m, canopy projection±3m, door placement±4m; connector widths±5m fill the partial-source gap to the observed central lobby, not surveyed whole-entry geometry; current signed entry accessibility/collision unknown

panelRhythm.method: coarse curved vertical and floor seam grid from actual photographs; not all>10000 reported unique facade panels reproduced
panelRhythm.uncertainty: panel count/pitch±35%; seam width±.05m; actual each different panel shape unknown

notes: Actual Blender export bound to hashes. Ground, collision, in-game appearance, day/night and performance remain unknown.

sourceInputs.basis: Authored PBR estimate from primary/reference photographs; no image textures or calibrated material measurements. Separate revision preserves previous candidate input hashes.

glbStats.scope: selected object meshes; bytes refer to whole shared GLB
